# jamfpro_v1_return_to_service (Resource)

Retrieve a Return to Service Configuration with the supplied id.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `display_name` (String) Display name of the Return to Service Configuration.
- `timeouts` (Block, Optional) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--timeouts))
- `wifi_profile_id` (String) Id of the wifi profile that is associated with the return to service configuration.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Id of the Return to Service Configuration.
